subject: EllipsisCorp RFP: SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence intake and timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Lewis <procurement@ellipsicorp.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@ellipsicorp.com
Date: 2027-05-16T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: Ellipsis RFP - controls & evidence intake

Diego,

Thanks for the quick response to our RFP. Attached is the control ask workbook we use to map vendors to our SIG/SOC2 baseline (Ellipsis_RFP_Control_Ask.xlsx). Our InfoSec team needs:

- A completed control mapping (column-aligned to the workbook)
- Representative evidence samples for key controls (authentication, encryption, key management, change control)
- A short SOC 2 summary (one page) and any ISO 27001 scope statement if you have one
- A point-of-contact and timeline for intake (we're aiming for a vendor review by 2027-05-24)

Can you confirm ownership and an estimated delivery date? Also please indicate any controls that require third-party attestation or subprocessor disclosures.

Attachment: Ellipsis_RFP_Control_Ask.xlsx (workbook)

Best,
Sarah Lewis
Senior Procurement Manager
EllipsisCorp
procurement@ellipsicorp.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <procurement@ellipsicorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T10:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Ellipsis RFP - controls & evidence intake

Sarah —

Thanks, received the workbook. Short answers up front: we can deliver a completed control mapping and representative evidence bundle by 2027-05-24, with a prioritized packet for the four key areas by 2027-05-20.

Plan:
- Today: we confirm owners and intake format and return a signed evidence manifest.
- 2027-05-18: prioritized evidence packet (authentication, encryption, key mgmt, change control)
- 2027-05-24: completed control mapping and full evidence bundle (redacted samples where needed)

Owners:
- Platform security & SOC 2 summary: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.com)
- KMS / key management artifacts: Jordan Blake (jordan_blake@redwood.com)
- Evidence packaging & redaction: Diego Fernandez (diego_fernandez@redwood.com)

We list the initial attachments we will send: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (one-pager), evidence_manifest_v1.zip (index of files), and the completed control mapping. If you prefer a shared Drive folder we can upload and send a link — otherwise we will attach the prioritized packet to the next email.

Are there any additional non-standard controls in your workbook we should flag? I noticed a couple of environment-specific asks under section C2; if those are must-haves, please call them out and we will escalate.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Solutions (Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T10:18:00-04:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Ellipsis RFP - owners & immediate actions

Team — quick kickoff for the Ellipsis RFP intake (external thread from procurement). Timeline is tight: prioritized packet to be delivered by 2027-05-18 and full mapping by 2027-05-24. Action items below.

Kimberly: please draft the one-page SOC 2 summary this afternoon. Include scope, timeframe of most recent audit, auditor name, and any carve-outs. Use the template in "/templates/soc2_onepager.docx" if helpful.

Jordan: collect KMS proof artifacts — key rotation policy excerpt, sample key rotation log (redacted), and where possible an HSM/KMS architecture diagram. If any items are third-party (cloud KMS), flag the subprocessor and provide the contract excerpt.

Mina: you'll own evidence packaging and redaction. Create the evidence_manifest_v1.zip index and keep filenames consistent with the workbook rows (row IDs). We need to ensure no PII is included in the samples.

Diego: I'll assemble the control mapping answers for the sections I own and coordinate with Legal if we need to push back on any contract-level asks.

If you hit blockers, ping me directly. We should avoid back-and-forth with procurement where possible — prefer consolidated packet.

Thanks — Diego

From: Sarah Lewis <procurement@ellipsicorp.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@ellipsicorp.com
Date: 2027-05-18T08:07:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Ellipsis RFP - controls & evidence intake

Diego —

Appreciate the plan and owners. A couple clarifications from audit:

1) For KMS we need a sample of the encryption-at-rest configuration for the region their tenant would land in (us-east-1). A redacted config or screenshot is acceptable.
2) Under control C2.4 (application code change approvals) we ask for an example PR with an approval trace — if you cannot supply a real PR due to confidentiality, a sanitized example with dates and approver names (roles acceptable) will work.
3) Please include a short note on retention for telemetry and keys — specifically maximum retention and purge cadence.

Also, we prefer the initial packet as Drive links rather than large attachments. If you can upload to a shared drive and send links, that will speed intake.

Link: DocuSign envelope for our vendor NDA (https://docusign.com/abc123-ellipsipec) — please sign so Legal can proceed.

Thanks,
Sarah
Senior Procurement Manager
EllipsisCorp

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@ellipsicorp.com>, procurement@ellipsicorp.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T16:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Ellipsis RFP - controls & evidence intake

Sarah — thanks for the clarifications. Quick status update and links below:

Status:
- Prioritized packet (authentication, encryption, KMS, change control) uploaded to shared drive — links below.
- SOC 2 one-pager attached to the drive.
- Evidence manifest (evidence_manifest_v1.zip) included in root.

Drive links: https://redwood.app/s/ELP-2027-RFP (prioritized packet and manifest)
DocuSign: we have signed and sent back the NDA (DocuSign envelope id: abc123-ellipsipec)

Notes on audit asks:
- KMS region config: we included a redacted us-east-1 KMS policy and a screenshot of the console showing key properties (kms_us-east-1_redacted.png).
- PR approval example: sanitized PR exported as PDF with approver roles (engineering-lead) and timestamps.
- Retention: telemetry (operational traces) default 90 days with archival options; keys follow KMS policy with active rotation every 90 days and purge/retention logged per the key lifecycle policy (excerpt included).

Attachments in Drive (representative):
- Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf
- evidence_manifest_v1.zip
- Redwood_us-east-1_KMS_policy_redacted.txt
- PR_approval_sanitized.pdf

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the prioritized packet satisfies audit's immediate needs. If audit wants full mapping earlier than 2027-05-24 we can reprioritize but will need a firm sign-off for redaction scope.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Solutions (Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference
